title: Security by construction
statement: Eliminate classes of vulnerability architecturally before relying on detection.
constraint: Claims limited to the verified enforcement boundary.

title: Financial integrity by construction
statement: Financial correctness is enforced by ledger invariants, typed transitions and independent reconciliation.
constraint: External systems remain authoritative for their own records; no legal characterization assumed.

title: Continuous automated assurance
statement: Assurance activities that software can perform continuously are designed to run continuously.
constraint: Automation is not independence; legal and auditor obligations unaffected.

title: Executable policies wherever feasible
statement: Policy obligations that are decisions or constraints are expressed as typed deterministic definitions.
constraint: Legal interpretation and human judgment are not forced into code.

title: Evidence through normal operations
statement: Evidence is emitted at authoritative enforcement points as a by-product of operating.
constraint: Hashes and immutable storage do not prove accuracy or completeness.

title: Independent verification of material outcomes
statement: Material outcomes are verified by a party or mechanism separate from the implementer.
constraint: Independent agent analysis, technically separated verification, organizational independence, qualified professional review and external attestation are distinct and never interchangeable.

title: AI-native organizational operations
statement: AI agents execute delegated work under explicit, externally enforced authority.
constraint: Agents never hold legal accountability or reserved human authority.

title: Minimal recurring human intervention
statement: Human effort is reserved for judgment, exceptions and reserved authority.
constraint: Necessary human accountability and independent judgment are preserved.

title: Shared assurance capabilities across products
statement: Assurance mechanisms are built once and reused by every product.
constraint: Product-specific legal and audit boundaries remain distinct.

title: Public transparency with appropriate confidentiality
statement: Standards, methods and sanitized results are public; sensitive evidence is restricted.
constraint: No confidential evidence, exploit detail or customer data in public outputs.

title: Deterministic enforcement of critical controls
statement: Critical restrictions are enforced by deterministic mechanisms outside any model.
constraint: AI instructions are guidance, not security boundaries.

title: Durable, attributable and reproducible decisions
statement: Decisions are recorded with authenticated attribution and can be reproduced.
constraint: Self-reported provenance is labelled as such until platform-bound.

title: Minimal architectural and operational complexity
statement: Prefer the smallest mechanism that meets the obligation; no new systems by default.
constraint: Simplicity never removes a mandatory obligation.

title: Incremental rather than duplicated assurance costs
statement: Each product adds only its incremental assurance cost.
constraint: Shared cost allocation is tracked and reconciled to actuals.

title: Essential operations function without AI
statement: Critical controls and essential operations have non-AI execution paths.
constraint: Degraded throughput is acceptable; loss of control is not.

title: External assurance as independent challenge
statement: External testers and auditors challenge our controls; they are not our primary discovery mechanism.
constraint: Mandatory external obligations are never reduced by internal automation unless the authority accepts it.

title: Evidence by construction
statement: Every system is designed to produce sufficient evidence that it operates correctly, securely and within its authorized boundaries; evidence generation is normal system behavior, not an audit feature.
constraint: Proportionality, privacy, confidentiality, completeness and verification requirements apply.

title: External professional services are not the default
statement: Uncertainty is first resolved by primary-source research, multiple-agent analysis, deterministic verification and architectural risk reduction. External professional services are reassessed when legally required, commercially necessary, or when material uncertainty cannot otherwise be resolved (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F).
constraint: Legitimate external obligations are never eliminated; internal research is never represented as qualified professional opinion; no expenditure is authorized by this tenet.
